senses.gloss:
__1 A kind of drink. 
__2 Splitting, rending.

__1 Passion, sentiment. 
__2 Singing, music. 
__3 (In music) A Rāga in which six of the seven primary notes are used; औडवः पञ्चभिः प्रोक्तः स्वरैः षङ्भिस्तु षाडवः । 
__4 Confectionery, sweetmeats; [[Suśr.]]

[षड् गुणा एव ष्यञ्] 
__1 The collection of six qualities. 
__2 Six expedients to be used by a king, six measures of royal policy; षाड्गुण्यसमुद्देशः [[Kau. A. 6]]; षाड्गुण्यमुपयुञ्जीत शक्त्यपेक्षी रसायनम् [[Śi. 2. 93]]; see under गुण also; षाड्गुण्यस्य प्रयोगेण तत्तन्मन्त्रबलेन च [[Śiva B. 11. 3.]] 
__3 Multiplication of anything by six. 
__4 Six properties. 
-Comp. 
-प्रयोगः employment of the six expedients or measures of royal policy.
